Strategy
Chapter 1 "Telescope"
Venice → Amsterdam → Amsterdam Tavern (Apricot Seeds delivery) →
Venice
Amsterdam Tavern requires Apricot Seedsx10, so procure them at Istanbul or a private farm.

Chapter 2 “Sea of ​​the Moon”
Venice → (Sailing days 60 days or more) Florence

Chapter 3 “Judgment”
Rome → Rome Church

Chapter 4 “House Arrest”
Florence

Recognition skill rank upper limit 20 → 21
